title: Make the selected preview category easier to spot
summary: A thin underline distinguishes the active category from a hovered category.

title: Keep preview filters available while scrolling
summary: The category controls stay at the top of the gallery while browsing a long list.
css: html .home-categories { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; padding-block: 8px; background: var(--color-background); }

title: Match preview focus rings to the card corners
summary: Keyboard focus follows the rounded preview card instead of a square outline.

title: Highlight preview borders on hover
summary: A light border identifies the preview under the pointer without moving the card.

title: Separate homepage and dashboard preview groups
summary: A quiet divider makes the two preview groups easier to scan.

title: Give the mobile introduction more line spacing
summary: The two-line introduction has more space between its lines on phones.

title: Use compact labels below preview cards
summary: Preview names use a restrained 16px size so the thumbnails keep their visual priority.

title: Give the focused color field a clearer border
summary: The focused color field gains a clear border while its keyboard focus ring stays in place.

title: Make the locked color state easier to recognize
summary: The lock control has a clear outline when the color is locked.

title: Give the color format selector more room
summary: The format selector has more space around its label and a larger desktop target.

title: Make the hue slider handle easier to track
summary: A slightly larger hue handle is easier to follow on the color track.

title: Make editable color values easier to read
summary: Color values use a readable 16px size in the desktop picker.

title: Make the exported code easier to read
summary: The code panel uses 14px text with comfortable line spacing.

title: Separate export actions from the code panel
summary: A thin divider gives the copy and download controls a clear action row.
css: html .export-dialog .dialog-actions { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); padding-top: 16px; gap: 16px; }

title: Make the font field labels easier to scan
summary: The heading and body labels use the same readable size as other form labels.

title: Give desktop font controls a comfortable target
summary: The desktop font selectors use a 44px height that matches the phone controls.

title: Show more of each palette color in quick picks
summary: Taller color strips make it easier to compare palette choices.

title: Make the current palette easier to find
summary: The selected palette caption has a distinct surface in addition to its outline and checkmark.

title: Highlight the palette under the pointer
summary: The hovered palette has a clearer border while its colors remain unchanged.

title: Separate removal from other saved-palette actions
summary: A divider separates Remove palette from actions that keep the saved palette.
css: html .palette-menu .palette-remove { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 12px; }
